ordered_steps.title: Post-Correction Authoritative Human Baseline
ordered_steps.complete_when: three complete reviewed-integration runs retain flight frame behavior, movement blocking, relocation-first-edit latency, queues, process CPU, memory, exact pins, and target misses without changing terrain behavior

ordered_steps.title: Real-Time Causal Terrain Pipeline Trace
ordered_steps.complete_when: input, movement, demand, storage, sampling, meshing, explicit transition-mask start, finish, and completion consumption, staging, render publication, collision publication, queue state, worker activity, main-thread time, and freeze intervals share causal identifiers and a bounded rolling trace with measured overhead

ordered_steps.title: Cautious Remediation And Exhaustion Review
ordered_steps.complete_when: only trace-proven bottlenecks receive one-variable standard remedies, each with A/B baseline comparison and full correctness plus human regression, followed by an independent CPU exhaustion and GPU-eligibility decision

cpu_b3_continuation.title: Temporary LOD Opening Causal Capture
cpu_b3_continuation.complete_when: a road-clear same-ray render opening with collision or authoritative density support, exact chunk state, and overlapping native lifecycle events classifies the opening as geometry, residency, retirement, visibility, or publication ordering without changing policy first; screenshots and aggregate queue counts cannot complete the step

cpu_b3_continuation.title: Flight Responsiveness Attribution
cpu_b3_continuation.complete_when: trace-off and trace-on evidence separates input latency, frame hitches, collision readiness, demand admission, and queue growth

cpu_b3_continuation.title: Regional Publication Component Audit
cpu_b3_continuation.complete_when: exact component membership and superseded viewer-plan ownership are accounted for across replacement generations

cpu_b3_continuation.title: One Trace-Proven Standard CPU Remedy
cpu_b3_continuation.complete_when: at most one newly proven factor changes and trace-off A/B, complete correctness, and human regression pass

cpu_b3_continuation.title: Repeated Independent Exhaustion Review
cpu_b3_continuation.complete_when: a fresh fail-closed report decides CPU exhaustion and TQP-58 eligibility against the resulting exact candidate

promotion_rules: CPU-B1 must retain measured misses rather than require an artificial pass
CPU-B2 is observation-only and must measure its own overhead
CPU-B2 transition evidence must pair explicit nonzero-mask start, successful finish, and consumed completion identities; aggregate counters are insufficient
CPU-B3 cannot start from queue sizes or aggregate timing alone; causal attribution is mandatory
each remediation changes one causal factor and preserves the retained correctness authority
a completed NOT_EXHAUSTED review returns CPU-B3 to its declared continuation rather than advancing TQP-58
TQP-58 remains blocked until CPU-B1, CPU-B2, and CPU-B3 pass in order
forbidden_shortcuts: scheduler reshuffling without causal trace evidence
increasing workers beyond the three-logical-CPU host boundary
weakening readiness, collision, topology, LOD, persistence, or publication correctness
selecting GPU acceleration solely because the CPU target is missed
using averages or screenshots as substitutes for event-order evidence
